source: sars-guide:PAYE-GEN-01-G21 Rev 1 p. 15 ("Employers must apply the percentage of employees' tax as indicated on the directive prior to considering allowable deductions (e.g. pension, retirement annuity fund contributions, etc.)") and p. 17 (IRP3(b))
notes: R30 000 commission earner, IRP3(b) directive of 20%, R3 000 retirement annuity (4006) through payroll. The percentage applies before the RA deduction: PAYE = 20% x 30 000 = 6 000.00 (the tables, after the RA, would give (27 000 x 12 = 324 000: 44 118 + 26% x 78 900 - 17 820) / 12 = 3 901.00). SDL is unaffected by the directive: 1% x (30 000 - 3 000) = 270.00 (G21 p. 12). UIF 177.12. Net 30 000 - 3 000 - 6 000 - 177.12. The calculator has no fixed-rate directive input.
